generations.zh: 当前代。两个 MoE 规格：Scout（17B-16E）与 Maverick（17B-128E），均为图像-文本多模态输入。
generations.en: Current generation. Two MoE builds: Scout (17B-16E) and Maverick (17B-128E), both with image-and-text multimodal input.

generations.zh: 小杯视觉线（1B / 3B）与 405B 大杯线（3.1）；当前生态里大量微调的源头。
generations.en: The small vision line (1B / 3B) and the 405B flagship (3.1); the origin of much of today's fine-tune ecosystem.

licenses.zh: Llama 4 Community License（license_name: llama4）——需登录接受条款；HF 页可逐条读许可全文
licenses.en: Llama 4 Community License (license_name: llama4) — gated, terms accepted on sign-in; full text readable on the HF page

claims.zh: HF 模型卡 metadata：Llama-4 两个规格均为 image-text-to-text 管线（图像+文本输入），支持 12 种语言（ar/de/en/es/fr/hi/id/it/pt/th/tl/vi）。
claims.en: HF model-card metadata: both Llama-4 builds are image-text-to-text (image + text input) and list 12 languages (ar/de/en/es/fr/hi/id/it/pt/th/tl/vi).

claims.zh: 许可原文（HF 门控页）：分发衍生作品须「prominently display "Built with Llama"」；月活超过 7 亿的产品须另行向 Meta 申请许可（Additional Commercial Terms 节）。
claims.en: Licence text (gated HF page): derivatives must "prominently display 'Built with Llama'"; products above 700M MAU need a separate licence from Meta (Additional Commercial Terms).

claims.zh: 官方未说明（本次核验）：Llama-4 的上下文长度未在可直抓的官方页给出——模型卡 README 为门控内容，llama.com 页有身份确认拦截。本站不转述未经核验的数字。
claims.en: Not officially stated (this check): Llama-4 context length was not available on publicly fetchable official pages — the model-card README is gated and llama.com sits behind an identity check. No unverified numbers are repeated here.

positioning.zh: 全球生态最大的开放权重家族：微调、量化、工具链覆盖最全，但许可是带归属条款（Built with Llama）与规模条款（7 亿 MAU）的社区许可，商用前读全文。
positioning.en: The largest open-weight ecosystem by far — fine-tunes, quantisations and tooling are everywhere — but the licence is a community licence with attribution ("Built with Llama") and scale (700M MAU) clauses. Read it fully before commercial use.

onSite.zh: 本站未收录 Llama 系列的量化对比：Llama-4-Scout 的第三方 GGUF 下载量约 3.8 万，未过 METHODOLOGY 的量化生态门槛（约 30 万）。要看量化对比，去 qwen3-8 / gemma-4 系列。
onSite.en: This site does not cover Llama quantisations: Llama-4-Scout's third-party GGUF downloads (~38k) fall below the METHODOLOGY ecosystem threshold (~300k). For quantisation coverage, see the qwen3-8 / gemma-4 series.
